## Model Description (Qwen3.6 Plus)
Qwen3.6 Plus is Alibaba Cloud’s native vision-language model with a 1M-token context window, image/text/video input, function calling, structured outputs, web search, context caching and batch inference. Alibaba positions it strongly for agentic coding, frontend programming, OCR and multimodal understanding.
